QC-ABOUT US-001 — About Qatar Chamber
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT US-001 | US-001 | REF:
FR-005
Title
About Qatar Chamber — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to access the About Us / Qatar
Chamber page so that I can view information about the organization, its
background, purpose, and key details
So that
I can learn about Qatar Chamber's
overview through structured content including text, images, and links
Preconditions:
- The About Qatar Chamber website is published and
accessible.
- The About Qatar Chamber page content is published in
the CMS.
Frontend Workflow:
- Public Visitor navigates to Main Menu → About Us → About Qatar Chamber.
- The page loads with the site-wide Hero Banner displaying a full-width red/maroon background with the Page Title ('About Qatar Chamber') overlaid in white and breadcrumb navigation ('Home > About Us') —
- Uploads or replaces the Hero Banner background image and sets alt text (EN + AR).
- The page loads with the Page Title ("About Qatar Chamber") and breadcrumb navigation ("Home > About Us").
- The page renders in a two-column layout: rich text content on the left, and an inline content image on the right.
- Left column displays: a primary section heading (e.g. "The Voice of Qatar's Private Sector"), introductory body paragraph, followed by additional content sections each with a section heading and structured content (bullet lists and/or numbered sub-lists as configured).
- Right column displays the configured Content Image (e.g. Qatar Chamber building photo) with alt text.
- Public Visitor scrolls through all content sections (e.g. Chamber's Competences, Chamber Constituents).
- Public Visitor may click any configured hyperlink within the content to navigate to internal or external resources.
Given the visitor opens the About Qatar Chamber page
When the page renders
Then:
- the site-wide Hero Banner shall display the Page Title and breadcrumb navigation ('Home > About Us') same as in the figma.
- the system shall display the Page Title, breadcrumb, and all published content sections as configured.
- the page shall render in a two-column layout: rich text content on the left and Content Image on the right.
- rich text shall support headings, paragraphs, bullet lists, numbered lists, and inline links.
- the Content Image shall display with the configured alt text for accessibility.
- hyperlinks shall be CMS-configurable and follow the approved open behaviour (same or new tab).
- only published page content shall appear on the website.
- the page shall render correctly in both LTR (EN) and RTL (AR) layouts.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If translation is missing for the selected language, the system shall fall back to the configured default language.
- If a hyperlink is broken, the link remains visible but the destination may return a 404.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the page fails to load, visitor shall see a standard error page.
- Draft content shall remain visible only in CMS and shall not appear on the website.
Post Condition:
Visitor can read all Qatar Chamber overview content and access any configured hyperlinks.
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT US-001 | US-002
| REF: FR-005
Title
About Qatar Chamber — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site
Content Editor / Site Content Author)
I want
to create, edit, and publish the About Qatar Chamber page content including bilingual text, images, and hyperlinks
So that
visitors can always access
accurate and up-to-date About Qatar Chamber information on the website
Preconditions:
- Admin has Site Content Editor or Site Content Author role in Liferay CMS.
- About Qatar Chamber page record is accessible in the CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
- Site Content Editor or Site Content Author logs into Liferay CMS.
- Opens the About Qatar Chamber page record.
- Creates or updates Hero Banner, Page Title (EN + AR), Page Content (EN + AR) including all section headings, body text, bullets, and numbered lists where permitted.
- Uploads or replaces the Content Image and sets alt text (EN + AR).
- Configures any hyperlinks within the rich text content.
- Saves content as draft or previews it.
- Publishes the page.
- System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast message (EN + AR).
- Published content reflects on the frontend after cache refresh.
Given the admin opens the About Qatar Chamber page record in CMS
When the admin updates and publishes the content
Then:
- the system shall allow the admin to create, edit, preview, publish, and unpublish the page where permitted.
- Site Content Author shall be able to view and update assigned page content where permitted.
- the system shall validate image format (JPG, PNG, SVG), image size (max 2 MB), content length, and URL format before save or publish.
- the system shall support draft → preview → publish → unpublish lifecycle.
- the system shall display a Liferay generic success toast message after each successful action (EN + AR).
- only published content shall appear on the website; draft content remains visible only in CMS.
- CMS stores updated content, updates page cache, and records the change in the audit log.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If Arabic title is missing and Arabic language is enabled: "Arabic title is required." | العنوان العربي مطلوب.
- If image size exceeds 2 MB: "Image size must not exceed 2 MB." | يجب ألا يتجاوز حجم الصورة 2 ميغابايت.
- If image format is invalid: "Image must be JPG, PNG, or SVG." | يجب أن تكون الصورة بتنسيق JPG أو PNG أو SVG.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." | تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post Condition:
Page content is published and visible on the website. Audit log records the change.
